{"title":"The Pond Concert and the Neighbor with the Quietest Ears","premise":"At a moonlit pond, Frog, Mia, and Teo plan a concert. A sleepy neighbor, a floating lily stage, and three very different ideas about music can turn the same concert into a serenade, a dance, or a tiny boat parade.","cast_and_props":"Characters: Frog, who wants to be admired for a grand performance; Mia, who wants a dance concert; Teo, who wants a soft song for someone tired; Nora, the quiet pond neighbor, who may want silence, a lullaby, or a place to sit. Props: lily.stage, bell, reed.flute, and leaf.boat. The shared setting is the pond edge at dusk. Every prop has a physical owner or location; no new props are invented in prose.","kernels_and_interactions":"Kernel families: (1) observe/tell beliefs about Nora's actual wish; (2) transfer ownership of the lily stage or leaf boat; (3) choose a concert style; (4) perform the chosen style; (5) change Nora's social response. Problem one: Frog assumes Nora wants a booming concert, but observation reveals she wants quiet; the consequence is a soft frog-song that makes Nora content. Problem two: Mia and Teo want incompatible performances; telling and trading the bell for the reed produces a call-and-response dance-lullaby. Problem three: the children assume Nora is only listening, but she owns the floating lily stage and wants to join from the water; an invitation and transfer make a boat parade. Shared scenes include gathering at the pond, observing the neighbor, choosing a style, and Frog's performance. The same observed fact can enable different choices.","seed_parameters":"The seed selects mode = rng.randrange(3). Mode 0 initializes frog.belief='loud', nora.want='quiet', lily.owner='frog'. Mode 1 initializes mia.want='dance', teo.want='lullaby', nora.want='lullaby', lily.owner='frog'. Mode 2 initializes nora.want='join', lily.owner='nora', leaf.boat.owner='nora'. premise_keys=('frog.belief','mia.want','lily.owner','nora.want'). outcome_keys=('concert.style','frog.performed','nora.content','lily.owner').","candidate_scenes":"```python
import random
from runtime import WorldSpec, Condition as C, scene, observe, tell, transfer

def build(seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed); mode=rng.randrange(3)
    entities={'frog':{'name':'Frog','kind':'animal'},'mia':{'name':'Mia','kind':'child'},'teo':{'name':'Teo','kind':'child'},'nora':{'name':'Nora','kind':'neighbor'},'lily':{'name':'floating lily','kind':'prop'},'bell':{'name':'silver bell','kind':'prop'},'reed':{'name':'reed flute','kind':'prop'},'boat':{'name':'leaf boat','kind':'prop'}}
    initial={
      'frog.belief':('loud' if mode==0 else 'unknown'),'frog.knows.nora.want':None,'frog.performed':False,
      'mia.want':('dance' if mode==1 else 'concert'),'teo.want':('lullaby' if mode==1 else 'concert'),'mia.knows.nora.want':None,
      'nora.want':('quiet' if mode==0 else 'lullaby' if mode==1 else 'join'),'nora.content':False,
      'lily.owner':('nora' if mode==2 else 'frog'),'bell.owner':'mia','reed.owner':'teo','boat.owner':'nora',
      'concert.style':'none','invitation.sent':False}
    scenes=(
      scene('gather','Gather',('frog','mia','teo'),set_values={'concert.style':'none'},summary='The performers gathered beside the pond',weight=1.2),
      observe('notice_nora','frog','nora.want',requires=(C('frog.knows.nora.want','eq',None),),summary='Frog watched Nora carefully'),
      tell('tell_nora','frog','mia','nora.want',when=(C('frog.knows.nora.want','ne',None),),summary='Frog told Mia what Nora wanted'),
      tell('tell_nora_teo','frog','teo','nora.want',when=(C('frog.knows.nora.want','ne',None),),summary='Frog told Teo what Nora wanted'),
      scene('choose_soft','Choice',('frog','teo'),when=(C('nora.want','eq','quiet'),C('frog.knows.nora.want','eq','quiet')),set_values={'concert.style':'soft'},summary='They chose a hush-soft concert',pivotal=True),
      scene('choose_duet','Choice',('mia','teo'),when=(C('mia.want','eq','dance'),C('teo.want','eq','lullaby'),C('nora.want','eq','lullaby')),set_values={'concert.style':'duet'},summary='They chose a dancing lullaby',pivotal=True),
      scene('invite_nora','Invitation',('mia','nora'),when=(C('nora.want','eq','join'),C('lily.owner','eq','nora')),set_values={'invitation.sent':True},summary='Mia invited Nora onto the water'),
      transfer('lend_lily','nora','frog','lily',when=(C('invitation.sent','eq',True),),summary='Nora lent the floating lily stage'),
      scene('choose_boat','Choice',('frog','mia','teo'),when=(C('nora.want','eq','join'),C('lily.owner','eq','frog')),set_values={'concert.style':'boat'},summary='They chose a floating boat concert',pivotal=True),
      transfer('trade_bell','mia','teo','bell',when=(C('concert.style','eq','duet'),),summary='Mia handed Teo the silver bell'),
      scene('perform_soft','Performance',('frog','teo'),when=(C('concert.style','eq','soft'),),set_values={'frog.performed':True,'nora.content':True},summary='Frog performed a soft pond song'),
      scene('perform_duet','Performance',('frog','mia','teo'),when=(C('concert.style','eq','duet'),C('bell.owner','eq','teo')),set_values={'frog.performed':True,'nora.content':True},summary='Frog performed a dancing lullaby'),
      scene('perform_boat','Performance',('frog','mia','teo','nora'),when=(C('concert.style','eq','boat'),C('lily.owner','eq','frog')),set_values={'frog.performed':True,'nora.content':True},summary='Frog performed from the floating lily'),
      scene('quiet_bow','Ending','frog',when=(C('concert.style','eq','soft'),C('frog.performed','eq',True)),set_values={'nora.content':True},summary='Nora smiled without making a sound'),
      scene('duet_bow','Ending','frog',when=(C('concert.style','eq','duet'),C('frog.performed','eq',True)),set_values={'nora.content':True},summary='Nora tapped the water in time'),
      scene('boat_bow','Ending','frog',when=(C('concert.style','eq','boat'),C('frog.performed','eq',True)),set_values={'nora.content':True},summary='Nora sailed the lily in a slow circle'),
    )
    return WorldSpec('Pond Concert',entities,initial,scenes,goal=(C('frog.performed','eq',True),C('nora.content','eq',True)),rules=(),labels={'concert.style':'concert style','nora.want':'Nora’s wish'},prune=True,premise_keys=('frog.belief','mia.want','lily.owner','nora.want'),outcome_keys=('concert.style','frog.performed','nora.content','lily.owner'))
```","constraints":"Use 5–10 selected events. The planner must not select tell_nora_teo unless it contributes to the duet or another enabled choice. A transfer requires the stated owner. Nora's wish is never spoken by Nora before it is observed and told. Performance must precede any ending card. Do not describe the bell, reed, lily, or boat as broken. The prose should show the consequences rather than explain a lesson.","different_endings":"Soft ending: the pond receives a tiny song, and Nora's eyelids lift as one round silver bubble rises beside her. Dancing-lullaby ending: Mia's feet patter, Teo's bell twinkles, and Nora taps the water until the ripples look like dancing commas. Boat-parade ending: Nora glides past on the lily while Frog sings from its middle, and the leaf boat bumps along behind like a very small royal carriage. Each ending needs two voice variants, guarded by concert.style and frog.performed, with no unguarded assertion about the selected style."}
